stories.headline: All support acts on Ed Sheeran's US tour quit after Macklemore dropped - BBC
stories.summary: The star said he was not responsible for Macklemore being dropped from the line-up after he made pro-Palestinian statements on stage.
stories.why: A major artist getting dropped from a tour over political speech signals the entertainment industry's fracture over Israel-Palestine—this isn't just celebrity drama, it's a test of whether speaking up on geopolitics costs you your career.

stories.headline: Zach Cregger’s ‘Resident Evil’: First Reactions From the Premiere - The Hollywood Reporter
stories.summary: The second reboot of Sony's action horror franchise hits theaters on Sept. 18.
stories.why: Zach Cregger directing a Resident Evil reboot matters because he's proven he can make visceral horror that actually lands with audiences (Barbarian); this signals studios are finally trusting indie horror sensibilities over tired blockbuster formulas.

stories.headline: 'Dancing With The Stars' Season 35 Premiere Recap: Who Went Home? - Deadline
stories.summary: The ballroom at CBS Television City was once again glittering with celebrities on Tuesday night to kick off Season 35 of 'Dancing with the Stars'
stories.why: DWTS remains the last major live entertainment event that makes normal celebrities relatable again—in an era of algorithmic content, it's one of few places where you see actual people learning something humbling in real-time on network TV.

stories.headline: As ‘American Idol’ Leaves Los Angeles for Atlanta, More Concerns Emerge About the State of Local Production - Variety
stories.summary: News that ABC's "American Idol" will leave Los Angeles and move to Atlanta has generated more concerns about the state of local production.
stories.why: American Idol leaving LA for Atlanta signals the collapse of legacy Hollywood production infrastructure; for men watching their hometowns lose the industry jobs that sustained the middle class, this is the visible proof that era is ending.

stories.headline: A Paris court awards Kim Kardashian 1 euro after her 2016 robbery - AP News
stories.summary: A Paris court has awarded Kim Kardashian 1 euro in compensation for an armed robbery she experienced in 2016. The court found eight people guilty last year for their roles in the robbery, which Karda…
stories.why: Kim Kardashian getting 1 euro in compensation despite criminals being convicted exposes how Europe's legal system offers zero protection to wealthy Americans—it's a power flex by a foreign court that ultimately matters less than the precedent it sets.

stories.headline: Emmys 2026: Broadcast In Memoriam Segment Excludes Robert Redford, Nicholas Brendon And More - TVLine
stories.summary: The 2026 Emmys In Memoriam segment excluded Robert Redford, Nicholas Brendon, Chuck Norris, and others while honoring Catherine O'Hara and more.
stories.why: Excluding Robert Redford and Chuck Norris from the Emmys In Memoriam isn't an oversight—it's the TV academy making a statement about whose legacies they value, signaling a generational erasure of the leading men who defined 20th-century masculinity.

stories.headline: The Tarot Horoscope For Wednesday, September 16 Has A Reading For Each Zodiac Sign - YourTango
stories.summary: The daily tarot horoscope is here for each zodiac sign on Wednesday, September 16, 2026.

stories.headline: Glam Lady Gaga cradles her baby as she touches down in LA with fiancé Michael Polansky - Page Six
stories.summary: Page Six broke the news last Friday that the couple, who met in 2019 and got engaged nearly five years later, recently welcomed their first child.
stories.why: Lady Gaga becoming a mother signals the normalization of high-powered female artists not needing to choose between career and family, reframing celebrity parenthood as a non-event rather than a career reset.
